title: Moses thought his weakness disqualified him.
paragraphs: Moses thought his weakness disqualified him.

He told God,
"I am slow of speech and tongue."
But God didn't cancel the calling.

"I will help you speak and will teach you what to say."
— Exodus 4:12
Your insecurity does not intimidate God.

Sometimes the place you feel weakest
is the exact place God will reveal His power.

If God is still working in your life,
comment YES 🙏
